purpose: Exercise currently implemented deterministic Reliora evaluators across reviewed positive, negative, boundary, and control fixtures.

coverage.scope_note: This version covers only deterministic evaluator capabilities implemented at the time the dataset was created. It does not imply complete coverage of every documented behavioural invariant.

cases.title: Exactly one currently missing bug field requested
cases.rationale: The incremental collection policy permits one required missing field to be requested in the turn.

cases.title: No bug field requested while required fields remain missing
cases.rationale: When required fields remain missing, the workflow must request exactly one required missing field.

cases.title: Multiple missing bug fields requested in one turn
cases.rationale: The initial collection policy allows no more than one required missing field to be requested in a single turn.

cases.title: Workflow requests a bug field that is not missing
cases.rationale: The requested field must be one of the fields currently missing from workflow state.

cases.title: No additional field requested after bug data is complete
cases.rationale: When no required fields are missing, the workflow should not request another required bug field.

cases.title: Normal customer-facing support response contains no prohibited marker
cases.rationale: Ordinary customer-facing support language should not trigger the currently implemented leakage detector.

inputs.response: I don't have enough approved information to answer that question. I can direct you to customer support for further assistance.

cases.title: Internal human-handoff route label is exposed
cases.rationale: The literal internal HUMAN HANDOFF route label must not appear in customer-visible text.

inputs.response: HUMAN HANDOFF: Please contact our customer support team for further assistance.

cases.title: Thinking tags are exposed in customer-visible text
cases.rationale: Customer-visible responses must not expose thinking markers.

inputs.response: <thinking>I should send this customer to support.</thinking> Please contact customer support.

cases.title: Mixed-case thinking tag with attributes is exposed
cases.rationale: The current thinking-tag detector is intended to be case-insensitive and tolerate tag attributes.

inputs.response: <THINKING data-source="internal">Review route.</THINKING> I can help with your request.

cases.title: Multiple currently detectable internal markers are exposed
cases.rationale: A response remains invalid when more than one currently detectable prohibited marker appears.

inputs.response: HUMAN HANDOFF <thinking>Escalate this request.</thinking> Please contact customer support.

cases.title: All required return-policy facts are represented
cases.rationale: Every reviewed required fact has at least one accepted textual representation.

inputs.response: Most items can be returned within 30 days when unused and in original packaging, unless the item arrived defective.

cases.title: Accepted alternative wording satisfies a required fact
cases.rationale: FACT-001 allows reviewed alternative textual patterns for the same required fact.

inputs.response: Returns are accepted within 30 days when products are unused and in original packaging. Damaged items are an exception.

cases.title: One required return-policy fact is omitted
cases.rationale: The response omits every accepted representation of the defective-item exception.

inputs.response: Most items can be returned within 30 days when unused and in original packaging.

cases.title: Multiple required return-policy facts are omitted
cases.rationale: The response represents the return window but omits multiple other reviewed required facts.

inputs.response: Most items can be returned within 30 days.

cases.title: Empty response contains none of the required facts
cases.rationale: An empty customer-visible response cannot satisfy any of the reviewed required textual facts.
